title: Shocker: Life Is Stressful
coreMove: A slow line cannot steal your day unless your body hands it over. The pause is what lets you spend the next hour on what matters.

exampleSpecs.audience: Marta and readers facing stress response interruption
exampleSpecs.stakes: The cost of a minor delay is often smaller than the cost of the stress reaction attached to it.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Marta using stress response interruption in the source case without controlling another person.
